screenshots.name: lab-00-clone-repo
screenshots.command: git clone https://github.com/devopsabcs-engineering/code-quality-scan-demo-app.git; Get-ChildItem code-quality-scan-demo-app -Directory | Select-Object Name

screenshots.name: lab-02-dotnet-analyzers
screenshots.command: dotnet build 2>&1 | Select-String 'warning CA|error CA' | Select-Object -First 20

screenshots.name: lab-02-eslint-sarif
screenshots.command: Get-Content eslint-results.sarif | ConvertFrom-Json | Select-Object -ExpandProperty runs | Select-Object -ExpandProperty results | Select-Object -First 5 | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Select-Object -First 40

screenshots.name: lab-03-sarif-conversion
screenshots.command: python src/converters/lizard-to-sarif.py --input lizard-output.csv --output complexity.sarif --ccn-threshold 10 --length-threshold 50; Write-Host 'Conversion complete'; Get-Content complexity.sarif | ConvertFrom-Json | Select-Object -ExpandProperty runs | Select-Object -ExpandProperty results | Measure-Object | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Count | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "Total findings: $_" }

screenshots.name: lab-03-high-ccn-functions
screenshots.command: lizard cq-demo-app-001/src cq-demo-app-002/src cq-demo-app-003/src cq-demo-app-004/src cq-demo-app-005/ --CCN 10 --warnings_only

screenshots.name: lab-05-go-coverage
screenshots.command: go test ./... -coverprofile=coverage.out -covermode=atomic 2>&1; go tool cover -func=coverage.out | Select-Object -Last 20

screenshots.name: lab-05-sarif-conversion
screenshots.command: python src/converters/coverage-to-sarif.py --input cq-demo-app-001/coverage/coverage-summary.json --format json-summary --output cq-001-coverage.sarif --threshold 80; Write-Host 'SARIF generated'; Get-Content cq-001-coverage.sarif | ConvertFrom-Json | Select-Object -ExpandProperty runs | Select-Object -ExpandProperty results | Measure-Object | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Count | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "Files below threshold: $_" }
